description.value: Moodswing Coffee + Bar is a plant-forward coffee shop and cocktail dive bar in New Westminster, operating out of a historic building on Front Street and formerly known as Old Crow Coffee Co. It serves creative craft cocktails and a fully plant-based small-plates menu of tacos, loaded nachos, and seasonal bites. The venue is also an active community hub hosting regular free events including open mics, vinyl DJ nights, and tabletop game evenings.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 47m; stands at 59m; rack at 90m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website identifies this business as 'Moodswing Coffee + Bar' at '655 front street, new west' (New Westminster), directly contradicting the OSM record's placement in North Vancouver and its name 'Mood Swing Bar' — a significant location and name discrepancy requiring flagging. The contact page confirms non-gendered washrooms (though the accessible one is temporarily out of service), and the bar menu page explicitly states a plant-forward food philosophy accommodating all dietary restrictions. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: LOCATION MISMATCH: OSM coordinates (49.2022, -122.9087) place this in North Vancouver, but the website's contact page clearly states the address is '655 front street, new west' (New Westminster). The OSM record appears to have incorrect coordinates.
NAME MISMATCH: OSM records the name as 'Mood Swing Bar' but the business's own website uses 'Moodswing Coffee + Bar'.

HOURS MISMATCH: OSM opening_hours tag shows 'Th-Sa 17:00-00:00' (evenings only), but the website lists 'Wed & Sun: 8am-3pm, Thu-Sat: 8am-11pm', indicating coffee service during daytime hours. OSM hours appear outdated or incomplete.
The contact email addresses still use @oldcrowcoffeeco.com, suggesting a rebranding from 'Old Crow Coffee Co.' that may not be fully complete in all systems.
The community field in OSM is 'North Vancouver' which is incorrect given the website address of New Westminster.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business with a confirmed website, current events, and detailed contact page. The location discrepancy should be corrected in OSM but does not affect directory inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business was formerly known as 'Old Crow Coffee Co.' and appears to have rebranded to 'Moodswing Coffee + Bar'. Located on unceded Qayqayt and Musqueam territories per the website. Parking available on Front Street mews with designated accessible parking noted.

Washrooms.detail: Non-gendered washroom with 1 toilet and 1 sink confirmed on contact page. Accessible washroom is currently out of service but being worked on. Staff provide accessible seating on request

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'All of our food is plant-forward and we make a concerted effort to offer nourishment to all dietary restrictions.' Entire food menu appears plant-based (tacos with cashew crema, mac'n'chez, plant weiner, etc.)

wow_evidence: plant-forward coffee shop and cocktail dive bar… hosting regular free events including open mics, vinyl DJ nights
